about.title: We dey help families chop well and stay well.
about.intro: Living Dose bring healthy food, your own nutrition plan and care from experts together, for price wey make sense for real families.
story: Plenty families dey live with sickness like sugar (diabetes) and high BP, wey better food and early care for help prevent. But healthy food fit hard to find, advice no dey fit everybody, and to see expert fit be like say e far.

Living Dose put everything for one place: food wey you don sabi, plans wey dem build for your health and your pocket, and experts wey dey near you for phone. We dey work direct with local farmers, so good food go cost less and e go reach you fresh.
about.mission: To bring healthy food wey no cost too much, nutrition support and care wey dey prevent sickness to every family, with technology, local food systems and the power of community.
about.vision: World where every family, no matter how much dem dey earn or where dem dey live, fit chop well, understand their health and get care before sickness start.
